summary: 10.0.34.20 Enterprise Release - Desktop Baseline Parity, Data Import Validation Error Transparency, Settings 5-Asset API Fix & Authentic Auth Split Layout
highlights: 1. Data Import Studio Error Reason Transparency: Upgraded the 7th column to 'Result / Error' and rendered exact validation messages alongside status badges with red row highlight for failed records matching Desktop ImportController.

2. Settings 5 Image Assets & AuthService Token Fix: Added getToken() alias in AuthService.js and unified token resolution across SettingsController.js. Bridged canonical Desktop keys (application.brandImagePath, application.markImagePath, company.logoPath, company.signaturePath, payment.qrImagePath) and alias keys, enabling full asset upload & preview parity.

3. Login Screen Full-Viewport Split Layout: Eliminated 960px constraints and black side voids on 1080p displays. Upgraded to full viewport split layout with authentic Jasvi Industries 5:1 banner and square J mark icon badge matching Desktop Image 3.

4. Spacious Registration & Forgot Password Layout: Dynamically expands auth container to wide card (860px) on tab switch to match Desktop's Registration.fxml 2-column grid and 3-step sequential cards.
